translationRepairs: Mapu yashu of a certain mirli xinjun
Mapu; yashu; a certain mirli; xinjun
The unpunctuated string is four coordinate offices—麻普, 牙書, 某彌裏, 辛袞—matching the preceding tribal-title list; the current literal wrongly makes them one possessive chain.
Founding ancestor Nieli focused on farming and crafts, and Taizu pressed the same priorities, though herding, hunting, and fishing stayed central to Khitan life.
Founding ancestor Nieli devoted himself to farming and crafts, and Taizu was especially earnest about the same, though herding, hunting, and fishing remained established custom.
究心 and 尤拳拳焉 mark Nieli’s and Taizu’s earnest attention to farming and crafts; 固俗尚也 is established custom, not ‘Khitan life,’ which the current idiomatic invents.
Bird-or-beast chief overseer, bird supervisor, beast supervisor, and Deer Xiangwen Office
Chief overseer of a given bird or beast, supervisor of a given bird, supervisor of a given beast, and the Deer Xiangwen Office
The unit lists four titles in sequence—監某鳥獸都監, 監某鳥, 監某獸, 監鹿詳穩司—each 某 marking a given bird or beast; the current phrasing drops that placeholder and fuses the first title.
s0166 is only 大惕隱司; 見帳官 belongs to the next unit, so the current idiomatic cross-reference is a copy error.
Vice overall deployment, chief overseer, and assessor—commandery titles in summary:
Vice overall deployment, chief overseer, and assessor—commander titles in summary:
諸指揮使職名總目 introduces commander (指揮使) titles, not commanderies; s0176 already renders 都指揮使 as commander-in-chief.
Vice Overall Deployment of a certain military and horse; Chief Overseer of a certain military and horse; Assessor of a certain overall deployment—General list of commandery titles:
Vice Overall Deployment of a certain military and horse; Chief Overseer of a certain military and horse; Assessor of a certain overall deployment—General list of commander titles:
The same heading 諸指揮使職名總目 is a general list of commander titles; ‘commandery’ misreads 指揮使 as a territorial commandery.
It had a military overall superintendent and an officer directing southern frontier affairs.
Nanjing Infantry and Cavalry Commander-in-Chief Office.
The Chinese names 南京馬步軍都指揮使司; the current idiomatic repeats offices from s0199 instead of this Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander-in-chief office.
There is a Military and Horse Overall Superintendent; there is an officer who overall directs Southern Face frontier affairs.
Nanjing Infantry and Cavalry Commander-in-Chief Office.
The literal likewise copies s0199 (兵馬都總管 / 總領南面邊事) rather than translating 南京馬步軍都指揮使司.
The above Northwest Circuit offices controlled frontier peoples.
The above Northwest Circuit offices controlled the various states.
控制諸國 means the offices controlled the various states, not ‘frontier peoples’; 諸國 is not 諸部 or 諸夷.
North, Northwest, Qisu River, and Chengqu Li Zubu State Great King Offices
North Zubu, Northwest Zubu, Qisu River, and Chengqu Li State Great King Offices
The original wrongly attaches 阻卜 to 城屈裏國大王府, which has none. The proposal correctly drops Zubu from Chengqu Li but also strips it from 北阻卜 and 西北阻卜; those first two offices must keep Zubu.
In the first year of Shengzong Tonghe the Huali Division requested that henceforth xiangwen be selected from within the division and not be permitted.
In the first year of Shengzong Tonghe the Huali Division requested that henceforth xiangwen be selected from within the division's own people; this was not permitted.
當部人內選授 is the Huali request to appoint xiangwen from their own people; 不許 is the separate court refusal, not part of what was requested.
